_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Pasila (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Platform level (tracks 1–11)
levels.name_source: Digitraffic infra-api laiturit via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-PSL/_report.json (Väylävirasto/Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0), read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pasila_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-PSL.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Helsingin laserkeilausaineisto 2021, © Helsingin kaupunki, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_PSL).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 33 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_PSL).
